correctness.rationale: For any L>=0 binary addition n+2n has at most one post-input carry. Kummer gives X=s2(n) and Y=the exact carry sum. A four-state weighted transducer includes the terminal carry, so P_L=e M^L f. Cramer determinants are exactly verified as polynomials N,D, giving the full rational generating function without sampling. Three formal derivatives and elementary coefficient extraction produce exact E[X], E[Y], E[XY] and the boxed covariance. A standard-library verifier checks symbolic determinant and derivative identities and enumerates finite cases independently. No infinite claim is based only on finite enumeration.
